source_sha_note: Pinned base commit; verify source_sha256 against your checkout when reproducing on another revision.

training.interpretation: Synthetic y=2x regression; unseen x values are a sanity check, not a real-world generalization benchmark.

methodology.timed_scope: zero_grad, forward, cross-entropy, backward, Adam update
methodology.summary: median of five trial mean step times; q25/q75 over those five means
methodology.excluded: model initialization, input generation, explicit pre-trial gc.collect, warmup
methodology.gc: Python garbage collection remains enabled during timed steps
methodology.backend_scope: native replaces Linear projections only; attention and the remaining graph stay on NumPy/Python
caveats: Synthetic random tokens and targets; timings assess execution cost, not useful language-model training.
Shared virtualized Linux CPU host; timings are local observations, not hardware-independent performance claims.
NumPy and the native extension may link different BLAS implementations; backend ratios include that difference.
No CUDA or GPU results are collected.
